rationale: The TurnPhase enum has no slot for 'runtime stopped without yielding to user.' Adding a new phase is forbidden by reviewer bound. Modifying awaiting_followup semantics globally is forbidden. Selecting streaming recreates the pre-CPL01 stuck-streaming bug. Selecting completed violates CRA02-committed (no terminal content was committed). Selecting error/resumable/idle is also wrong for orthogonal reasons.
